President Donald Trump said he is weighing joining strikes on the Iranian-backed rebels); Trump’s Zelensky attack, Russia diesel deal draw criticism in U.S. and abroad (Several Republicans objected to Trump's stance. “I do believe there’s a legitimate case for saying the president’s not following the law, said Sen. Thom Tillis); and Pope will have surgery after doctors discover nodule in his lung (Pope Leo XIV said that the nodule was “detected at a very early stage and is well localized,” and that the surgery would be in the coming days). Markets leaned higher, with 4 of 7 tracked indexes up; S&P BSE SENSEX down 0.79% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Zod 4.6.6 compromised by malware? (TypeScript-first schema validation with static type inference - Fix bugs and improve performance · colinhacks/zod@d821685); Postgres isn't slow, your storage is (A recap of Sai Srirampur's POSETTE 2026 talk on storage performance in Postgres, with a local NVMe vs. EBS benchmark and the production...); and Type-safe HTML templating in Zig (I’ve done a lot of web development over the years. I started around the year 2000, just after PHP 3.0 was released and started taking over...). Product Hunt features ngram 2.0 (Create explainers, screencasts, and AI avatar videos), Strawberry (The AI browser where teams and agents work together), and Kudos 3.0 (The AI that finds money you're missing and gets it back).

headlines.summary: PENSACOLA, Florida — Four people died in the southeastern United States as post-tropical cyclone Isaias threatened flooding and tornado risks over the weekend as it moved northward after making landfall on Florida's Gulf Coast.

hackerNews.title: Type-safe HTML templating in Zig
hackerNews.summary: I’ve done a lot of web development over the years. I started around the year 2000, just after PHP 3.0 was released and started taking over the web world. I’ve used all kinds of approaches for generating HTML: raw PHP, string concatenation in Python, Smarty templates in PHP, Template Toolkit in Perl, and Jinja/Django templates in Python. Then, as the world moved on to SPAs and JavaScript frameworks, I stopped working on frontends.
